title: REQ · untrackNodeModules untracks via git rm -r --cached and unstages vitest results.json, with a CLI script
summary: Cleanup function with injectable git runner and package.json script.
description: Context: node_modules files and the vitest results.json cache are tracked/staged. Desired: untrackNodeModules(run) issues git rm -r --cached for node_modules and unstages node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json; npm script runs it against real git.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fake runner, when untrackNodeModules runs, then it calls git with args including 'rm','-r','--cached' and 'node_modules'.
Given a fake runner, when it runs, then no command deletes files from disk (no plain 'rm' or '-f' without --cached) and results.json is unstaged.
technical_constraints: Real runner uses node:child_process execFileSync without shell
